contea di ritrovamento: Kent (Inghilterra e Galles)

330-335AD. Roman. Copper alloy, Contantine I (The Great) numus AE4. Length 14.3mm, Width 13.8mm, Thickness 1.7mm, Diameter 14.3mm, Weight 0.7g. Obverse: Draped, laureate bust right. Inscription: CONSTAN[]. Reverse: Two soldiers holding two standards. Inscription: (GLORIA EXERC)ITVS. Die Axis: 0 deg. or 12 o'clock. Little wear, circular coin but struck slightly off centre. Attractive dark green patina with rusty pale brown surface deposit in a number of places. Ref. Coins of England and the UK, Spink 2009, page 61-62 No. 599A, Identifying Roman Coins, Richard reece and Simon James, Seaby 1986, reprint 1994, page 28-29 No. 97 & 99 and Roman Coins and their Values, David R. Sear, 4th revised…
